title: What are symmetric monoidal categories?
summary: Symmetric monoidal categories have been understood since the 1960's and are central to many branches of mathematics. In particular, the construction of spectra from symmetric monoidal categories is at the heart of algebraic $K$-theory. This construction starts from either categories with an action by a suitable operad $\sP$ or with suitable functors from the category $\sF$ of finite sets to the category $\mathbf{Cat}$ of categories.
